#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <string>
#include <climits>
#include <cctype>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

const int INF = 1000000;
const int dirs[4][2] = {{-1,0},{0,-1},{0,1},{1,0}};

int n, t, start_x, start_y, dist_limit[10][10];
string grid_person[10], grid_capsul[10];
int bfs_dist[10][10];

struct FlowEdge {
    int to, capacity, reverse_idx;
    FlowEdge(int to_, int cap, int rev) : to(to_), capacity(cap), reverse_idx(rev) {}
};

vector<vector<FlowEdge>> flow_graph;
vector<int> level, iter;

void add_flow_edge(vector<vector<FlowEdge>>& g, int u, int v, int cap) {
    g[u].emplace_back(v, cap, g[v].size());
    g[v].emplace_back(u, 0, g[u].size() - 1);
}

void bfs_level(vector<vector<FlowEdge>>& g, int s) {
    fill(level.begin(), level.end(), -1);
    queue<int> q;
    level[s] = 0;
    q.push(s);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int u = q.front(); q.pop();
        for (const auto& e : g[u]) {
            if (e.capacity > 0 && level[e.to] < 0) {
                level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                q.push(e.to);
            }
        }
    }
}

int dfs_flow(int u, int sink, int flow) {
    if (u == sink) return flow;
    for (int& i = iter[u]; i < g[u].size(); ++i) {
        FlowEdge& e = g[u][i];
        if (e.capacity > 0 && level[u] < level[e.to]) {
            int pushed = dfs_flow(e.to, sink, min(flow, e.capacity));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                e.capacity -= pushed;
                g[e.to][e.reverse_idx].capacity += pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int dinic_flow(vector<vector<FlowEdge>>& g, int s, int t) {
    int total = 0;
    level.assign(g.size(), -1);
    iter.assign(g.size(), 0);
    while (true) {
        bfs_level(g, s);
        if (level[t] < 0) break;
        fill(iter.begin(), iter.end(), 0);
        int pushed;
        while ((pushed = dfs_flow(s, t, INF)) > 0) {
            total += pushed;
        }
    }
    return total;
}

bool path_exists(int sy, int sx, int gy, int gx) {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
            bfs_dist[i][j] = INF;
    bfs_dist[sy][sx] = 0;
    queue<pair<int, int>> q;
    q.emplace(sy, sx);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int y = q.front().first, x = q.front().second; q.pop();
        if (y == gy && x == gx) return true;
        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
            int ny = y + dirs[d][0], nx = x + dirs[d][1];
            if (ny < 0 || nx < 0 || ny >= n || nx >= n) continue;
            if (grid_person[ny][nx] == 'Z' || grid_person[ny][nx] == 'Y') continue;
            int nd = bfs_dist[y][x] + 1;
            if (nd > t) continue;
            if (nd <= dist_limit[ny][nx] && bfs_dist[ny][nx] > nd) {
                bfs_dist[ny][nx] = nd;
                q.emplace(ny, nx);
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}

void process() {
    cin >> n >> t;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) cin >> grid_person[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) cin >> grid_capsul[i];

    vector<int> px, py, cx, cy;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (isdigit(grid_person[i][j]) && grid_person[i][j] != '0') {
                py.push_back(i);
                px.push_back(j);
            }
            if (isdigit(grid_capsul[i][j]) && grid_capsul[i][j] != '0') {
                cy.push_back(i);
                cx.push_back(j);
            }
            if (grid_person[i][j] == 'Z') {
                start_y = i;
                start_x = j;
            }
            dist_limit[i][j] = INF;
        }

    dist_limit[start_y][start_x] = 0;
    queue<pair<int, int>> q;
    q.emplace(start_y, start_x);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int y = q.front().first, x = q.front().second; q.pop();
        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
            int ny = y + dirs[d][0], nx = x + dirs[d][1];
            if (ny < 0 || nx < 0 || ny >= n || nx >= n) continue;
            if (grid_person[ny][nx] == 'Z' || grid_person[ny][nx] == 'Y') continue;
            if (dist_limit[ny][nx] == INF) {
                dist_limit[ny][nx] = dist_limit[y][x] + 1;
                q.emplace(ny, nx);
            }
        }
    }

    int m = px.size() + cx.size() + 2;
    flow_graph.assign(m, vector<FlowEdge>());
    for (int i = 0; i < px.size(); ++i)
        add_flow_edge(flow_graph, m - 2, i, grid_person[py[i]][px[i]] - '0');
    for (int i = 0; i < cx.size(); ++i)
        add_flow_edge(flow_graph, m - 1, i + px.size(), grid_capsul[cy[i]][cx[i]] - '0');

    for (int i = 0; i < px.size(); ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < cx.size(); ++j)
            if (path_exists(py[i], px[i], cy[j], cx[j]))
                add_flow_edge(flow_graph, i, j + px.size(), 1);

    cout << dinic_flow(flow_graph, m - 2, m - 1) << endl;
}

int main() {
    process();
    return 0;
}
